title: Every file of a theme's design system is checked against the code: Nocturne's 348 files get rules, snapshots and a test that lists each gap
detail:
scripts/ds-intake.mjs snapshots a design-system folder (inventory with sha256, tokens, copy) and diffs it against the last snapshot; scripts/design-system.test.ts measures the repo against the snapshot in CI. Opening baseline: every gap found on 2026-10-28 (shots, 13 kit accents, violet, kit data, product surfaces, page copy), each closed by the Nocturne build pull requests that follow. ADR-1920.

Routine, rules for 348 files, snapshots and CI test landed; baseline holds the opening gaps.

verify.evidence: Every file of the Nocturne snapshot is claimed by a rule.
